List available on-demand datasets

Source: R/data.R
list_datasets.Rd

Returns a table of the perturbational signature datasets available via get_dataset(), with a short description and original data source for each.

Usage

list_datasets()

Value

A data.frame with columns name, description, source.

Examples

list_datasets()
#>                   name
#> 1    drugmatrix.kidney
#> 2     drugmatrix.liver
#> 3         sciplex.a549
#> 4         sciplex.k562
#> 5         sciplex.mcf7
#> 6      perturbseq.k562
#> 7      perturbseq.rpe1
#> 8        neurips2023.b
#> 9       neurips2023.nk
#> 10       neurips2023.t
#> 11 neurips2023.myeloid

#> 13    gtex.brain.hippo
#> 14          tahoe.a498
#> 15         tahoe.hct15

#> 17          tahoe.lovo
